Rashi on Yevamot 29b:10:1.hebrew: בעל כרחה - דקני לה ונעשית כאשתו לכל דבר בביאה בע"כ, שאין בה חופה:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:10:1.english: Against her will - For he acquires her and she becomes like his wife in every respect through intercourse against her will, in which there is no wedding canopy.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:11:1.hebrew: וחלה עליו זיקת אירוסין - ונשואין של שאר נשים, ואם בא עליה לאחר מאמר בלא חופה, לא קנה:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:11:1.english: And the bond of betrothal takes effect upon him - and [the] marriage [laws] of other women; and if he has intercourse with her after levirate betrothal without a wedding canopy, he has not acquired [her].

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:12:1.english: Let him nullify - One of them [may nullify] her vow.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:12:2.hebrew: לאחד ולא לשנים - שומרת יבם א' יפר, אבל שומרת לשני יבמין לא יפר לא זה ולא זה:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:12:2.english: To one, but not to two - [If she is] a widow waiting for one yavam, he may nullify [her vows]; but [if she is] waiting for two yevamin, neither this one nor that one may nullify [them].

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:13:1.english: There is no levirate bond - [To the extent] that she should be [considered] like a married woman.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:13:2.hebrew: ואפילו בחד - היכא דליכא אלא חד, דודאי עליה רמיא, אפ"ה אין זיקה:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:13:2.english: And even with one - Where there is only one [brother], so that she certainly falls to him [for levirate marriage], even so, there is no levirate bond.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:13:3.hebrew: לתרי אין זיקה - דלא ידעינן להי מינייהו רמיא, ואפילו שניהם כאחד אין הפרתן הפרה, דקלישא זיקתן:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:13:3.english: For two [brothers], there is no levirate bond - Because we do not know to which of them she falls [in levirate obligation], and even [if] both of them [nullify her vows] together, their nullification is not a [valid] nullification, because their levirate bond is weak.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:13:4.hebrew: אלא לתרי אמאי - נהי נמי דיש זיקה אפי' לתרי, מיהו יפרו שניהם מיבעי ליה:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:13:4.english: But [if there are] two, why - Even though there is a levirate bond even with two [yevamin], nevertheless [he] should have [said], "Both of them must nullify [her vows]."

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:14:1.english: We read: "And Rami bar Abba said."

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:15:1.english: In partnership - He and her father, like a betrothed [woman].

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:16:1.english: To preclude the rival wife - [Referring] to her sister who fell before him after the ma'amar of this one.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:16:2.hebrew: דלא סגי לה בגט - העושה מאמר ביבמה ובא להוציאה, בעיא חליצה וגט, ולא אמרינן ככנוסה היא וסגי לה בגט:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:16:2.english: That a bill of divorce would not suffice for her - One who performs levirate betrothal [ma'amar] with a yevama and comes to send her away requires ḥalitza and a bill of divorce, and we do not say she is like a married [woman] and a bill of divorce suffices for her.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:17:1.hebrew: אמר לך רבי אלעזר ולרב נחמן מי ניחא - כלומר: נהי נמי דקונה, בשלמא אי נישואין עושה, שפיר; אלא לרב נחמן דאמר לא עביד אלא אירוסין, מי ניחא? הא בשותפות ליכא למימר, דיפר קתני, יפרו מיבעי ליה:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:17:1.english: Rabbi Elazar [could have] said to you: And as for Rav Nachman, does [this] work out well? - That is to say: even granting that [it] acquires [her], it is well if it effects marriage; but according to Rav Nachman, who says it effects only betrothal, does [this] work out well? One cannot say [that he nullifies her vows] in partnership [with her father], since [the mishnah] teaches "he may nullify" — it should have [taught] "they may nullify".

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:17:2.hebrew: אלא הכא במאי עסקינן שעמדה בדין - לדידי [אפילו] בלא מאמר, ולרב [אמי] אחר מאמר, ולא רצה לכנוס ולא לפטור:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:17:2.english: Rather, with what are we dealing here? [Where] she stood in court - According to me, [even] without ma'amar [levirate betrothal], and according to Rav [Ami], after ma'amar, and he did not want to take [her] in marriage or to release [her via ḥalitza].

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:17:3.hebrew: ופסקו לה מזונות משלו - כדתניא לקמן בהחולץ (יבמות דף מא:): עמד בדין וברח, נזונית משל יבם. דמהשתא בעלה הוא, ועל דעתו נודרת, על מנת שירצה:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:17:3.english: And they assigned her sustenance from his [property] - As it is taught in a baraita later in [the chapter entitled] HaCholetz (Yevamot 41b): [If] he stood in court and fled, she is sustained from the yavam's [property]. For from now on he is [considered] her husband, and she takes vows with his consent, on condition that he approves.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:1:1.hebrew: ואי מאמר לב"ש קונה קנין גמור - זה יעשה מאמר בזו ויקנה אותה קנין גמור להיות אשתו, דהא אין איסור במאמר, ותצא אחותה מעליו, ולא הויא הך אחות זקוקתו, ויכנוס את אשתו:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:1:1.english: And if levirate betrothal according to Beit Shammai acquires [her] as a full-fledged acquisition - This [brother] should perform levirate betrothal with this [sister] and acquire her [with] a full-fledged acquisition to be his wife, for there is no prohibition in levirate betrothal; and her sister will [thereby] be released from him, so this [woman] will not be the sister of a woman bound to him [by a levirate bond], and he may [then] consummate the marriage with his wife.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:2:1.hebrew: אלא מאי כו' - נהי נמי דלא קני קנין גמור, הא אמרת דוחה בצרה, ותקשה לך נמי: יעשה מאמר בזו, ותדחה אחותה, ויכנוס את אשתו:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:2:1.english: Rather, what, etc. - Even though [levirate betrothal] does not acquire [her with] a complete acquisition, behold, you said [that it] precludes a rival wife; so let it also be a difficulty for you: let him perform levirate betrothal with this one, and her sister will be precluded, and he will consummate [the marriage with] his wife.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:3:1.hebrew: דהיתירא דחי - מאמר שנעשה בהיתר, דאי הוה בעי לייבומי בשעת מאמר, הוה מצי לייבומי, כגון במתני', דעדיין לא נפלה אחותה:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:3:1.english: [Levirate betrothal] in a permitted [state] precludes - [This refers to] a levirate betrothal that was performed in a permitted [state], for if he had wanted to perform levirate marriage at the time of the levirate betrothal, he would have been able to perform levirate marriage, such as in the Mishnah, where her sister had not yet fallen [for levirate marriage].

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:3:2.english: [Levirate betrothal] under forbidden [circumstances] - For example, where the two sisters fell [before the brothers for levirate marriage] prior to [the] levirate betrothal.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:3:3.english: Here too - with respect to acquisition.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:4:1.hebrew: וצרתה - אחותה שנעשית לה צרה בזיקה, חליצה נמי לא תיבעי, דתצא משום אחות אשה:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:4:1.english: And her rival wife - Her sister who became a rival wife to her through the levirate bond, [that] she should not require ḥalitza either, for she is exempt on account of [being] a wife's sister.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:4:2.english: Rather, it precludes - her [the rival wife] from prohibiting the wife of the one who performed levirate betrothal to him.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:4:3.hebrew: ומשייר - דבעיא חליצה אם באת לינשא, עד שלא כנס היבם את בעלת המאמר. ולקמיה פריך ליה: הא קתני "הלזו תצא משום אחות אשה", דמשמע אף מחליצה:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:4:3.english: And leaves a remnant - That [the rival wife] requires ḥalitza if she comes to marry [another man] before the yavam has married the woman who received levirate betrothal. And later [the Gemara] challenges him: Behold, it teaches, "This one shall leave on account of [being] a wife's sister," which implies [that she is exempt] even from ḥalitza.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:5:1.hebrew: זה יעשה מאמר וידחה - את אחותה מעליו, ואח"כ ישא את זו. אלא לאו משום דלא דחי דחייה גמורה, וכל כמה דרמיא עליה לחליצה, זקוקתו היא ואוסרת את זו עליו:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:5:1.english: This [brother] should perform levirate betrothal and preclude - her sister from himself, and afterward he may marry this one. Rather, [is it] not because it does not preclude [her with] a complete preclusion, and as long as she falls upon him for chalitzah, she is his zekukah [woman bound to him by the levirate tie] and renders this one forbidden to him.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:6:1.hebrew: ה"ג אלא יבמה דחזיא כו' - כלומר, אלא לעולם דוחה דחייה גמורה, ודקשיא לך התם נמי לידחי — לא דמיא למתניתין, דהכא דכי נפלה ועבד מאמר הוה חזיא לכולהו מילי דיבמה — להתייבם ולחלוץ — הלכך חזיא למקצתייהו, למאמר, דמאמר דחיא אחותה לכשתפול. אבל התם, דתרוייהו נפלו קודם מאמר ולא חזיא לכולהו מילי דיבמה, לא חזיא למקצתה; לפיכך אין מאמר דוחה אחותה:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:6:1.english: This is the reading: Rather, a yevama who is suitable, etc. - That is to say: rather, [ma'amar, i.e., levirate betrothal,] in fact pushes [her] aside with a complete rejection. And as for your difficulty that there too it should push [her] aside — [that case] is not comparable to our Mishnah. For here, when she fell [for levirate marriage] and he performed ma'amar, she was suitable for all matters of a yevama — to enter into levirate marriage and to perform ḥalitza — therefore she is suitable for part of them, [namely] for ma'amar, so that ma'amar pushes aside her sister when she falls [for levirate marriage]. However there, where both of them fell before ma'amar and she is not suitable for all matters of a yevama, she is not suitable for part of it; therefore ma'amar does not push aside her sister.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:8:1.hebrew: השתא ארוסה - דקידושין דידה דאוריית', תני רבי חייא אינו יורשה ואינו מטמא לה. מאמר יבמין מדרבנן הוא, דהא מדאורייתא "יבמה יבא עליה" כתב רחמנא, מיבעיא:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:8:1.english: Now, a betrothed woman - whose betrothal is by Torah law — Rabbi Ḥiyya teaches [that] he does not inherit from her and does not become ritually impure for her. Levirate betrothal is by rabbinic law, for by Torah law the Merciful One wrote, "her husband's brother shall cohabit with her" — is it necessary [to state]?

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:8:2.english: [He is] not an onen - to be forbidden [from partaking] of consecrated food.

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:8:3.hebrew: ולא מיטמא - אם כהן הוא, דהא לאו שארו הקרוב אליו היא:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:8:3.english: And he does not become ritually impure - If he is a priest, for she is not "his kin who is near to him."

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:8:4.english: Similarly, she does not enter acute mourning - to be forbidden from [eating] consecrated [foods].

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:8:5.hebrew: ולא מיטמאת - אינה צריכה להתעסק בו. ולאו דוקא נקט "ולא מיטמאת", דהא בנות אהרן לא הוזהרו על הטומאה, אלא איידי דנקט "לא אוננת" דאיצטריך ליה, נקט "ולא מיטמאת", דבעי למתני תרתי בדידה ובדידיה — כך שמעתי. ולי נראה: "ולא מיטמאה" — כגון ברגל, שישראלים מוזהרים על הטומאה מ"ונבלתם לא תגעו", במס' ר"ה (דף טז:):
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:8:5.english: And she does not become ritually impure - She does not need to attend to him [for burial]. And [the tanna] did not state "and she does not become ritually impure" precisely, for the daughters of Aaron were not warned against ritual impurity; rather, since he stated "she does not enter acute mourning," which was necessary for him [to teach], he [also] stated "and she does not become ritually impure," because he wanted to teach two [halakhot] regarding her and regarding him — so I have heard. But it appears to me [that] "she does not become ritually impure" [applies] for example on a festival, when Israelites are warned against ritual impurity, [derived] from [the verse] "and their carcass you shall not touch," in Tractate Rosh Hashanah (16b).

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:8:6.hebrew: גובה כתובתה - ובדכתב לה מן האירוסין מיתוקמא, בכתובות בפרק הכותב (כתובות דף פט:):
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:8:6.english: She collects her marriage contract - And [this] is established [as referring to a case] where he wrote [it] for her from [the time of] betrothal, in Ketubot, in the chapter [entitled] HaKotev (Ketubot 89b).

Rashi on Yevamot 29b:9:1.hebrew: ולא בעיא מסירה לחופה - דאם בא עליה בעל כרחה בלא חופה, קני; ואי בעי תו לאפוקי, בגיטא סגיא לה:
Rashi on Yevamot 29b:9:1.english: And she does not require delivery to a wedding canopy - For if he has intercourse with her against her will without a wedding canopy, he acquires [her]; and if he subsequently wishes to divorce [her], a bill of divorce suffices for her.

Tosafot on Yevamot 29b:15:1.hebrew: אביה ובעלה מפירים נדריה - ואם אין לה אב או שאינה ברשות אב, לא מצי מיפר, כדאמרינן בנדרים (דף עא.):
Tosafot on Yevamot 29b:15:1.english: Her father and her husband nullify her vows - And if she has no father, or she is not under [her] father's authority, he cannot nullify [her vows], as we say in Nedarim (71a).

Tosafot on Yevamot 29b:17:1.hebrew: כגון שעמדה בדין כו' - לפי מסקנא שאיירי דעבד בה מאמר, כדמוכח בנדרים בפ' נערה המאורסה (נדרים עד.): דלר' אליעזר, כיון דעביד בה מאמר ופסקו לה מזונות משלו — נודרת על דעתו; ולר' יהושע, דוקא בחד יבם, אבל בתרי, כיון דאי בעי אחוה פסיל לה עליה בביאה או בגיטא — אינה נודרת על דעתו; ולר"ע, אפילו ביבם אחד קאמר דלא יפר, אפילו עבד בה מאמר, משום דאין חייבים עליה סקילה כנערה המאורסה. ולא יתכן לפי זה מה שפי' בקונטרס בריש פ"ב (לעיל יבמות יז: ד"ה ולימא), דמאן דאמר אין זיקה אפי' בחד היינו ר"ע — דמצי סבר דיש זיקה, ואפי' הכי לא יפר, משום דאין חייבין עליה סקילה:
Tosafot on Yevamot 29b:17:1.english: Such as where she stood in court, etc. - According to the conclusion [of the Gemara], where it is dealing with [a case] in which he performed ma'amar [levirate betrothal] with her, as is proven in Nedarim in the chapter [entitled] Na'arah HaMe'orasah (Nedarim 74a): For according to Rabbi Eliezer, since he performed ma'amar with her and [the court] ruled [to provide] her sustenance from his [property], she vows with his consent; and according to Rabbi Yehoshua, [this applies] specifically with one yavam, but with two [yevamim], since if his brother wishes he can disqualify her to him through intercourse or through a get [bill of divorce], she does not vow with his consent; and according to Rabbi Akiva, even with one yavam he says that he cannot nullify [her vows], even if he performed ma'amar with her, because [adulterers] are not liable for stoning on her account like [with] a betrothed maiden. And according to this, what Rashi explained at the beginning of the second chapter (above, Yevamot 17b, s.v. Veleima) — that the one who says there is no zikah [levirate bond] even with one [yavam] is Rabbi Akiva — is not plausible; for he can hold that there is zikah, and even so he cannot nullify [her vows], because they are not liable for stoning on her account.

Tosafot on Yevamot 29b:1:1.hebrew: יעשה מאמר ויקנה כו' - ומשום ביטול מצות יבמין ליכא למיחש, כדפרישית בפ' שני (לעיל יבמות דף יח:):
Tosafot on Yevamot 29b:1:1.english: "[He] should perform ma'amar [levirate betrothal] and acquire, etc." - And there is no [need] to be concerned about nullifying the mitzvah of yevamim, as I explained in the second chapter (above, Yevamot 18b).

Tosafot on Yevamot 29b:8:1.hebrew: לא מיטמאה לו - פירוש: ברגל, שהוזהרו על הטומאה, כדאמרינן בר"ה (דף טז:). ועוד י"ל: דאין מטמאה לו, היינו דאינה חייבת ליטמא לו, למאן דאמר בסוטה (דף ג.): "לה יטמא" — חובה:
Tosafot on Yevamot 29b:8:1.english: "She does not become ritually impure for him" - Explanation: On a festival, when [Israelites] were warned against ritual impurity, as we say in Rosh Hashanah (16b). And furthermore, one can say that "she does not become ritually impure for him" means that she is not obligated to become ritually impure for him, according to the one who says in Sotah (3a) [regarding the verse], "for her he shall become ritually impure" — [that it is] an obligation.

Tosafot on Yevamot 29b:8:2.hebrew: עבד בה מאמר מיבעיא - וא"ת: דמשמע דלא עדיפא בעלת מאמר מארוסה, ובהחולץ (לקמן יבמות דף לט. ושם) קאמר רבא גופיה: מאמר לב"ש עושה ודאי ארוסה לדחות בצרה, וספק נשואה לחלוק בנכסים — אלמא מהני ליורשה? וי"ל: דהכא גרס רבה, רבו של אביי, דמסיק עלה "אמר ליה אביי"; ולקמן גרס רבא, שהוא אחר אביי:
Tosafot on Yevamot 29b:8:2.english: "[If] he performed levirate betrothal (ma'amar) with her, is it necessary [to say]?" - And if you ask: This implies that a woman who received ma'amar is no better than an [ordinary] betrothed woman, yet in [chapter] HaCholetz (later, Yevamot 39a and there [in the commentary]) Rava himself says: Ma'amar, according to Beit Shammai, renders [her] definitely betrothed with respect to rejecting a rival wife, and doubtfully married with respect to sharing in the property — thus [we see that] it is effective for [him] to inherit from her? And one can answer: Here [the text] reads Rabbah, the teacher of Abaye, as [the Gemara] concludes on this [statement], "Abaye said to him"; whereas later [the text] reads Rava, who was after Abaye.

Tosafot on Yevamot 29b:9:1.hebrew: אלא לענין מסירה לחופה - וא"ת מאי משני? דהשתא נמי תקשי: השתא ארוסה בעלמא בעיא מסירה לחופה, עבד בה מאמר מיבעיא? וי"ל דעבד בה מאמר ובא עליה, והביאה עושה אותה ככנוסה:
Tosafot on Yevamot 29b:9:1.english: Rather, [the question relates] to the matter of delivery to a wedding canopy - And if you ask: What is [the Gemara] answering? For now too, there is a difficulty: Now, [if] an ordinary betrothed woman requires delivery to a wedding canopy, [if] he performed ma'amar with her, is there any question [that she requires it]? And one can answer that [the Gemara is speaking of a case where] he performed ma'amar with her and engaged in intercourse with her, and the intercourse renders her like a married woman [who has already entered the wedding canopy].
